title: Autumn Orchard
description: An autumn orchard of translucent ochre, rust and sage fields, with delicate botanical marks, a hillside village and a winding teal stream.
alt: Patchwork autumn orchard framed by dark trees, with fine botanical lines, a cream hillside village and a winding blue stream.

landscape.label: Landscape composition
landscape.provenance: Exact approved desktop PNG supplied by Ian Rastall on 2026-10-22. Created with built-in image_gen as a Paul Klee-inspired reinterpretation of the earlier Bauhaus orchard. Generated at 1672×941, then resampled with System.Drawing HighQualityBicubic to 3840×2160 with a slight aspect adjustment; not native 4K. Preserved without further alteration.

portrait.label: Separate phone composition
portrait.alt: Tall patchwork autumn orchard between framing trees, with a cream village above terraces and a blue stream winding down the foreground.
portrait.provenance: Separately composed with built-in image_gen on 2026-10-22 using the approved landscape as reference. Untouched 830×1896 generated output; prompt in docs/klee-orchard-generation.json.

allowUpscale.phone: Required 1080×2340 phone output exceeds the separately generated 830×1896 portrait. Lanczos3 enlargement is explicit.

compositionReview: Reviewed on 2026-10-22: the separate portrait retains both framing trunks, village, orchard terraces and the winding stream. Centered 6:13 removes only narrow top/bottom strips. The 9:16 crop prioritizes the village and stream, removing outer canopy and lowest foreground. Tablet and 16:10 favor the village and stream; ultrawide retains the village and orchard with reduced upper canopy and foreground. Landscape source was already enlarged before submission; all landscape downloads inherit that prior enlargement.
